title: Scene-cut-triggered private residual birth
hypothesis: A predeclared scene-cut detector can allocate small private residual state only at cut windows, preserving cut quality with lower total bytes than always-private scene models and fewer errors than shared-only code.
physical_object: Shared neural video decoder plus a limited local private residual bank.
mirror_coordinate: Scene/cut coordinate m with optional private patch birth.
logical_multiplicity: New scene-specific function only at measured cuts while retaining shared decoder elsewhere.

development.selection_metric: Not run; multi-scene cut dataset/native model unavailable.

success_gate: Not evaluated; require predeclared development birth criterion and fresh scene-cut windows.
blockers: No multi-scene video dataset with verified cut boundaries in workspace; available HNeRV sample is one Bunny scene.
No NerVast/shared-private adaptive INR implementation/checkpoint for native control.
No CUDA/NVIDIA GPU for actual video decode-rate comparison.
boundaries: Do not relabel Bunny temporal windows as scene cuts.
Do not use synthetic cut construction as a natural-video result.
